code_path_0_0_8_2.chunking: _op.py chunking_by_token_size: step = chunk size minus overlap = 1100 tokens, so a document of n tokens gives ceil(n/1100) chunks; the last can be almost wholly overlap. Chunks with identical text collapse by hash.

defaults.where: graphrag.py lines 57-125; the runs read them back from the GraphRAG object (defaults_observed in each scenario)

code_path_0_0_8_2.description_summary: _op.py _handle_entity_relation_summary: when an entity or a relation is merged and its joined descriptions are at least 500 tokens long, one call to the cheap model (max_tokens 500). Otherwise no call.
code_path_0_0_8_2.embeddings: vdb_nanovectordb.py upsert: only entities by default (text = entity name plus description; no chunk embeddings unless enable_naive_rag), 32 texts per request, up to 16 requests at once. An entity touched by a later insert is embedded again.
code_path_0_0_8_2.entity_extraction: _op.py extract_entities: for every chunk one extraction call (best model) and, with the default gleaning of 1, one 'continue' call whose prompt carries the whole first prompt and the model's first answer. With the default of 1 the loop-check ('YES | NO') call is never made (the loop breaks before it); with a gleaning setting of 2 or more it is made after each round and the loop goes on while the model answers yes. All chunks of one insert call run concurrently, at most 16 at a time.
code_path_0_0_8_2.graph_and_communities: graphrag.py ainsert: every insert call drops the stored community reports, clusters again (hierarchical Leiden on the largest connected component only, gdb_networkx.py 34-41 and 203) and writes one best-model call per community, JSON mode (response_format json_object). A community whose prompt is byte-identical to an earlier one is answered from the response cache and makes no call.
code_path_0_0_8_2.response_cache: _llm.py openai_complete_if_cache: key is the md5 of (model, messages); on by default; the whole cache file is rewritten after every call (a time cost, not a token cost).
code_path_0_0_8_2.retries: _llm.py: tenacity, 5 attempts (3 for the Azure functions), waits 4 to 10 s, on RateLimitError and APIConnectionError only. The OpenAI SDK also retries on its own: max_retries is 2 in the installed SDK (measured, openai_sdk_defaults in each scenario). A community report whose answer holds no parsable JSON raises in convert_response_to_json and ends the insert (from reading the code; not run).
code_path_0_0_8_2.telemetry: No networking code in nano_graphrag/*.py (grep for requests, urllib, http, posthog, telemetry, analytics, sentry found only a comment URL). Dependencies were not audited; see the observed attempts below.

depends_on_answers: Prompt tokens of the 'continue' calls (they resend the model's first answer: 140,802 with shape A against 169,024 with shape B)
Entities per chunk, hence embedding inputs (0 against 234 per-document or 224 batch)
Whether any description summary call happens (needs a merged description of 500 tokens or more; shape B produced none)

Number and size of community reports: only the largest connected component is clustered (110 of 224 nodes with shape B), and unchanged communities are served from the cache (48 report calls per-document with cache, 161 without, 29 in one batch insert; all with shape B)
Number of loop-check calls if gleaning is set above 1
Retries on rate-limit or connection errors (provider behaviour)
Whether a report answer is valid JSON (a bad one ends the insert)
independent_of_answers: Number of extraction calls (one per chunk: 49 here, which equals the arithmetic ceil(tokens/1100) summed over the documents)
Number of 'continue' calls at the default gleaning of 1 (one per chunk)
Prompt tokens of the extraction calls (the template and the chunk text)

determinism_check_sensitivity.what: The determinism comparison was made to fail on purpose: a copy of the runner whose shape-B answers append 3 random bytes to the snippet was run twice (perdoc-B) in a scratch directory. compare() then reported not identical on final.by_kind, final.stub_summary and prompt_multiset_sha256, and also against the good run. The call counts per kind were still equal, so the prompt tokens and the prompt hashes are what catch it.

compared: final.by_kind (calls, prompt and completion tokens, models, embedding inputs)
prompt_multiset_sha256 (every prompt's SHA-256 with kind, model, path and token count, sorted)

install.method: uv venv --python 3.12 DIR; uv pip install --python DIR/bin/python nano-graphrag==0.0.8.2 (uv 0.13.6)
install.python_3_13_attempt: 3.13.18: install exit 0 and `import nano_graphrag` works (SyntaxWarnings from graspologic and hyppo docstrings). uv printed 'Building hnswlib==0.8.0' and 'Building numpy==1.26.4' (numpy 1.26.4 has no 3.13 wheel; graspologic pins numpy<2), and installed graspologic 3.4.4 although its metadata says <3.13. Why uv allowed that was not investigated. No scenario was run on 3.13. Python 3.14 and 3.15 were not tried.
install.result_primary: exit 0, 100 packages installed, no workaround, and uv printed no 'Building' line. hnswlib is sdist-only on PyPI (checked on its PyPI JSON); the installed copy is a locally built cp312 macosx_11_0_arm64 wheel (setuptools) that uv took from its local cache; where that cache entry came from is unstated.
install.tiktoken_vocabulary: The builder calls tiktoken.encoding_for_model('gpt-4o') (o200k_base) when it chunks, and tiktoken downloads that vocabulary from a Microsoft Azure blob URL on first use (URL in tiktoken_ext/openai_public.py). I fetched o200k_base and cl100k_base once, with tiktoken, into a cache directory before the offline runs and pointed TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR at it. The runs themselves made no download.
